<description>
Use Guix to produce a `-static-pie` bitcoind using GCC `14.3.0` and glibc `2.44`. Using glibc for static builds, would be less of a leap compared to switching to musl libc (POC in #23203).

[`-static-pie`](https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc/Link-Options.html)
[quoted text omitted]
A static position independent executable is similar to a static executable,
but can be loaded at any address without a dynamic linker.

```bash
# file bitcoind
	ELF 64-bit LSB pie executable, x86-64, version 1 (GNU/Linux), static-pie linked, for GNU/Linux 3.2.0, stripped

# ldd bitcoind
	statically linked
```

### Tested on:
- [ ] Alpine 3.24
- [ ] CentOS 9
- [ ] Debian 11
- [ ] Debian 13
- [ ] NixOS
- [ ] Ubuntu 20.04
- [ ] Ubuntu 26.04

Related upstream links / discussions:
* [[RFC] Avoiding dlopen in statically linked applications that use nss](https://sourceware.org/pipermail/libc-alpha/2023-May/148682.html)
* [arm: add -static-pie support](https://www.mail-archive.com/gcc-patches@gcc.gnu.org/msg288303.html)

Also fixes #19075.

Based on #36272 & #36193.
</description>

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..19d3f88e0d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-25573.md
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+Build
+-----
+
+Release binaries for x86_64 and aarch64 Linux (except
+for bitcoin-qt) are now compiled with `-static-pie`,
+making them more portable. They can now be run on non-glibc
+based systems, as well as on systems than ship with older
+glibcs, than were previously supported.
+
+A side-effect of this change is that name resolution through
+dynamic nss modules is not possible. Users using mdns (.local),
+LDAP, or SSSD to resolve names for local connections should
+verify that connections are still resolved correctly. (#25573)

+     }

+# Static binary will have:
+# no imported, or exported symbols
+#   single 0-value dynamic symbol for x86_64

+# no library dependencies
+# no interpreter (redundant second check)
+def check_ELF_STATIC(binary) -> bool:
+    assert len(binary.dynamic_symbols) <= 3
+    assert len(binary.imported_symbols) == 0
+    assert len(binary.libraries) == 0
+    assert binary.concrete.interpreter == ""

+

+

+                check_ELF_STATIC(binary)
+
+            else: # non-static
+                for (name, func) in CHECKS[etype]:
+                    if not func(binary):
